codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly bridges features.json to the SQLite worker pool, handles preconditions and priorities, creates the exact requested payload, respects the budget via acquireWorkerSlot, and handles errors gracefully without throwing. The test file is comprehensive and covers all 7 VAL-WD-* assertions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker ran `node scripts/format-tracked.mjs --write` instead of the documented `pnpm format` command.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows worker executing `node scripts/format-tracked.mjs --write` after `pnpm format:check` failed, whereas AGENTS.md instructs: 'If format fails, run: pnpm format then re-check'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker immediately releases the budget slot after enqueuing the message (`slot.release()`), noting in comments that 'in the real dispatcher, the slot is passed to the worker'. This indicates ambiguity in where budget enforcement occurs (enqueue time vs execution time).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .claude/lib/mission/worker-features-dispatcher.cjs:107-109 — 'Release the budget slot after successful enqueue / Note: In the real dispatcher, the slot is passed to the worker'

summary: The feature was correctly implemented, fulfilling all described requirements. Comprehensive tests were written and pass. A minor convention deviation (running a script directly instead of `pnpm format`) was observed, along with a note on budget slot handling.
